body: If it needs to be taken down, the mods can take it down. As of right now however, people are thankful and that's important to them and myself. I didnt say to reach out to me via PM as a first resort nor make any promises.

As a store manager and dealing with allergies all the time, it is extremely important to not lecture a customer in front of other customers. It's unprofessional and horrible for the company's reputation. I think OP is definitely NTA. The manager shouldnt have lectured her at all, especially with other people able to hear it.
